anchor.quote: Let $q = \lceil n/b \rceil$ be the number of digits in each input, as on that page.
The radix is $Q_0 = 2^b$, the number of values a digit can take
The index $j$ runs over the positions $0, 1, \dots$ of the coefficient list
the output is the list of integer coefficients $c_0, c_1, \dots$ of the product of the two digit polynomials.
The digit $d_j$ is the $j$th base-$Q_0$ digit of the output
The carry $\gamma_j$ is the amount carried into position $j$ from the lower positions.
here $h$ is a summation index, the position of an already processed coefficient, running over $0 \le h < j$.
where $w \bmod Q_0$ is the remainder of $w$ on division by $Q_0$
